Decompilation reveals standard logic for the 'env' command, including parsing command-line arguments (getopt_long), manipulating environment variables (putenv, unsetenv, environ), changing working directories (chdir), and executing subsequent processes (execvp). The code includes official GNU strings, help documentation, and links to gnu.org and the GPL license. No suspicious or malicious behaviors were identified.
